title: Idle
motion: Gentle floating, small gaze shifts, soft double blink.

title: Planning
motion: Upward eye drift, curious head tilt, offset blink.
behavior: LLM producing goal and writeSet; arms down.

title: Routing
behavior: Selector and scorer choosing DAG; one arm up.

title: Awaiting approval
behavior: Low-confidence pause or proposal; both arms up. Repeat callout every 2 min.

title: Blocked
behavior: Queued for locks; dim amber; arms down.

title: Disconnected
behavior: No PING for 5 s. Reconnect restores authoritative current state.

title: No motor power
behavior: Persistent plug-slash badge; retain current run color. Shown on executing.

title: Teammate joined
behavior: Join animation + callout; restore current state. White shown over idle.

title: Teammate left
behavior: Leave animation + callout; restore current state. White shown over idle.

title: Routing / cache
behavior: Cached router selection; same routing color, cache indicator.

title: Routing / fallback
behavior: LLM fallback; same routing color, fallback indicator + callout on mode change.

title: Speaking
behavior: Audio overlay; retain current state eyes and color. Shown on planning.

title: Paused
behavior: Pause at step boundary. Proposed visual: amber + pause marker.
